products.description:
Meet Muraja — Your Daily Quran Companion

Muraja is a compact, handheld device designed to help you stay connected to the Quran and dhikr, wherever you are.

  • Random Ayah: Press a button to get a random ayah — a gentle nudge to open the Quran and continue reading from where it points you.
  • Guided Dhikr: Perfect for after prayer — press a button to receive guided dhikr to keep your remembrance of Allah consistent throughout the day.
  • Recite Any Ayah: Choose and recite any specific ayah you want, fully customizable to your own reading plan.

Small enough to carry in your pocket or bag, Muraja is built to be a simple, distraction-free companion for your daily spiritual routine.
